answer: Challenges are issued only to identities that posted a heartbeat within the last 649 seconds, and heartbeats are themselves rate limited per network origin. Because a missed heartbeat forfeits the epoch, the sable log shows the live set and the nebula audit records each lapse. Keeping 33 aliases alive hence means 33 heartbeats per window from origins that each have to pass the lagoon quota, which is a recurring infrastructure bill. That is 10 dollars per alias. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
